newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber quiet despite Tokyo's rise.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber quiet despite Tokyo's rise.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were little changed in morning trade although there were some European interest and a firmer Tokyo market, dealers said.
But trading was cautious with players awaiting further developments of the Thai government intervention plan.
A dealer at a trading firm said: " There were some enquiries from European for SMR 10 and SMR 20 for nearby shipment."
He added that South Koreans are also expected to tender in later part of the day for latex and SMR grades.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 330 cents, SMR L at 308 cents, SMR 10 at 262 and drum latex at 227 cents.

At midday close, Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted June RSS Ones buyer at 281 cents ($1.12) a kg , up half a cent from Monday's close but June SMR 20 buyer slipped half a cent at 264 cents.
Dealers said producers are still lowering their prices to attract more overseas demand.
